name: Rating
purpose: Collect a short ordered score, present a repeated-star aggregate, or present a compact one-star numeric summary.
useWhen: A person chooses a score on a short ordered scale, or an aggregate score needs recognizable repeated-star presentation.

avoidWhen.condition: The value is a general numeric setting, a named choice, progress, or status.
avoidWhen.useInstead: Slider, Radio Group, Progress, or Badge

composition: For input, compose Root with one Item for every endpoint and use it as the sole control in Field or name the standalone Root.
For aggregate product or review data, use Display with repeated stars or Summary with one star and a visible value; give either a localized label and do not use readOnly Root as a passive summary.

rules.statement: Use Root and Item only when the person can choose a score; use Display for aggregate or read-only presentation so passive content does not create a focusable slider.

Give Display and Summary a localized label that states the score and maximum, such as label="4.5 out of 5 stars"; use Summary valueText for localized visible formatting and keep adjacent review counts as ordinary text.
Provide one visible Field label for an input Rating or a complete accessible name for a standalone Root.
Load styles.css or core.css plus rating.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using readOnly Root to show a product's average rating, creating a focusable slider that cannot be changed.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Rating.Display for aggregate scores and reserve readOnly Root for rare form review states where slider semantics remain meaningful.

commonMistakes.mistake: Making every star focusable, repeating the score through five accessible icons, or relying on star color alone.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep one logical Root for input or one labelled Display image for aggregate output; repeated artwork stays decorative.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using max=1 or an ordinary star Icon to fake a compact aggregate rating.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Rating.Summary so one decorative star and the visible numeric value share one localized aggregate label.

validation: For input, check pointer, touch, keyboard, fractional values, form ownership, reset, disabled, read-only, invalid, and Field relationships.
For Display and Summary, check the localized accessible name, absence from tab order, aggregate geometry, RTL, forced colors, zoom, and long adjacent review text.
